title: 第21章 突飞猛进炼体踏入第二重第22章 剑道第二重
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
当第一批带着绝望之心的百姓来到广场时，他们呆住了，满脸的难以置信，陷入了深深的震撼中，难以言语。
紧接着是第二批，第三批……同样陷入震撼中。
所有来到广场的临荒城百姓，全部呆呆地望着插在旗杆上的狼头，那是魔狼王的脑袋，头顶闪闪发光的独角是他独有的标志。
“魔狼王被斩首了？”
众人一脸惊愕，望向广场高台上那丰神如玉的染血少年，在夕阳的照耀下，身影变得格外伟岸，宛若天神。
李易微微抱拳，宏声道：“各位朋友，本人幸不辱命，今日斩杀为祸多年的魔狼王，座下妖兽尽数伏诛，还临荒城一个太平，从此再无一头妖兽敢来侵犯。”
听到此话。
在场所有人全部愣住了，片刻后，爆发出雷霆般的欢呼声，许多人喜极而泣，哭得很伤心。
三十年了。
临荒城的百姓从当年的三十多万锐减至十来万，就是魔狼王与其座下妖兽食人导致的，现在这些罪魁祸首死了，临荒城终于能得到安宁。
“这些孩子的父母亲人，请迅速上来带他们回家。”
李易让李凡打开铁牢，将一百童男童女从里面放出。
“大哥哥，我父母不同意我离开。”
之前有灵性，胆子很大的可爱女童，被一名风韵犹存的中年妇女抱着过来，小脸上写满了遗憾，其后跟着一名猎户打扮的中年男子，脸上刻满了风霜。
“恩公，我们不想再失去女儿了。”
这对中年夫妇跪在地上，泪眼婆娑，乞求地望着李易。
“灵儿还小，有父母陪伴才能快乐成长。”
李易将中年夫妇扶起，对旁边弯腰站着的文士王智勇说道，“王主簿，灵儿一家就交给你多照顾了。”
“属下定当不辱使命。”
文士赶紧答应，并自称属下。

“我不是你的上司，这只是一个嘱托，记住不许再为虎作伥，否则等我下次来时，定叫你身首异处；如果灵儿想修行，你就让沈向武教她，这是我给灵儿和沈向武的灵石和丹药，你先帮着保管，好自为之。”
李易将一瓶极品聚气丹和一百中品灵石，交给文士。
“明白。”
文士当即站正，双手慎重接过丹药和灵石。
“我们走了。”
李易看了一眼依旧昏迷的沈向武，见他气息平稳，没有生命危险，当即召唤出天剑，与李凡踏上剑身，冲天而去。
“他是剑仙，剑仙显灵了！”
所有人纷纷跪倒在地，进行膜拜，他们都是凡人，地处偏僻，哪里见过御剑飞行的修行者，认为李易是仙人。
自此，临荒城留下了一段剑仙降世，铲除妖魔的神话传说。
“大哥哥，再见！”
楚灵儿挥手告别，水灵灵的大眼里满是不舍，小脑袋里留下了一段至生难忘的画面。
“哥，这种仗剑走天下，行侠仗义的感觉实在太爽了。”
李凡满脸兴奋，张开双臂迎着风自由的翱翔。
“小凡，等我们炼化妖兽的内丹，并用真血洗礼后，就会变得更强，以后有的是机会行侠仗义。”
李易拍了拍李凡的肩膀，很快就御剑回到了魔狼王的洞府。
这里没有任何变化，妖兽和人的尸体横七竖八地摆放在两旁，堆积如山，血流成河。
“如此多妖兽内丹与真血，一定能助我踏入太一吞天诀第三重，开辟肉身元府。”
content_en:
When the first group of desperate people came to the square, they were stunned, their faces full of disbelief, and they were deeply shocked, unable to speak.
The second batch followed, and the third batch... were also shocked.
All the people of Linhuang City who came to the square stared blankly at the wolf head stuck on the flagpole. It was the head of the Demon Wolf King, and the shining horn on the top of his head was his unique symbol.
"The Demon Wolf King was beheaded?"
Everyone looked in astonishment and looked at the jade-like blood-stained young man on the high platform of the square. Under the light of the setting sun, his figure became particularly majestic, like a god.
Li Yi slightly clasped his fists and said loudly: "Dear friends, I am lucky enough to live up to my fate. Today I killed the Demonic Wolf King, who has caused trouble for many years. All the monsters and beasts under his command have been killed, and the deserted city has been restored to peace. From now on, no monsters dare to invade."
Hear this.
Everyone present was stunned. After a moment, thunderous cheers broke out. Many people cried with joy and sadness.
Thirty years.
The population of Linhuang City dropped sharply from more than 300,000 to over 100,000, which was caused by the Demonic Wolf King and his cannibal beasts. Now that these culprits are dead, Linhuang City can finally find peace.
"Parents and relatives of these children, please come up quickly and take them home."
Li Yi asked Li Fan to open the iron prison and release a hundred boys and girls from it.
"Brother, my parents don't agree with me leaving."
The lovely girl who was smart and courageous before was carried over by a middle-aged woman who still had charm, with regret written all over her little face. She was followed by a middle-aged man dressed as an Orion, with his face full of wind and frost.
"My dear friend, we don't want to lose our daughter again."
The middle-aged couple knelt on the ground, with tears in their eyes, looking at Li Yi pleadingly.
"Ling'er is still young and can only grow up happily with the company of his parents."
Li Yi helped the middle-aged couple up and said to the scribe Wang Zhiyong who was standing next to him, "Master Wang, I will leave the Ling'er family to you to take care of them."
"I will definitely fulfill my mission."
The scribe quickly agreed and called himself his subordinate.
"I'm not your boss. This is just a request. Remember not to act as a savior again, otherwise when I come next time, you will be dismembered. If Ling'er wants to practice, you can ask Shen Xiangwu to teach her. These are the spiritual stones and elixirs I gave to Ling'er and Shen Xiangwu. You can help keep them first so that they can take care of themselves."
Li Yi handed over a bottle of top-grade Qi Gathering Pill and a hundred medium-grade spiritual stones to the scribe.
"Understood."
The scribe immediately stood upright and carefully took the elixir and spirit stone with both hands.
"We're leaving."
Li Yi glanced at Shen Xiangwu, who was still unconscious, and saw that his breath was stable and his life was not in danger. He immediately summoned the Heavenly Sword, stepped on the sword with Li Fan, and soared into the sky.
"He is the Sword Immortal, and the Sword Immortal has appeared!"
Everyone knelt down on the ground and worshiped. They were all mortals and they were in a remote place. They had never seen practitioners flying with swords and thought Li Yi was an immortal.
Since then, Linhuang City has left behind a myth and legend of the sword fairy coming to the world to eradicate demons.
"Big brother, goodbye!"
Chu Ling'er waved goodbye, Shui Lingling's big eyes were full of reluctance, and an unforgettable scene was left in her little head.
"Brother, it feels so good to walk around the world with a sword and act like a hero."
Li Fan's face was full of excitement, and he opened his arms to fly freely in the wind.
"Xiao Fan, after we refine the inner elixir of the monster and baptize it with true blood, we will become stronger, and there will be many opportunities to do heroic deeds in the future."
Li Yi patted Li Fan on the shoulder and quickly returned to the Demon Wolf King's cave with his sword.
There is no change here. The corpses of monsters and humans are scattered on both sides, piled up like mountains, and blood flows like rivers.
"Such demonic beast inner elixirs and true blood will definitely help me step into the third level of Tai Yi Tian Swallowing Technique and open up the Yuan Palace of the physical body."
